Refunds reported as applied: [{"order_id": 122, "amount_cents": 5470}, {"order_id": 124, "amount_cents": 1085}]

hold_reason: Refund for order 121 (5261 cents) was requested in this batch but does not appear in the refunds table. list_refunds shows only order 122 (5470) and order 124 (1085). W2 also reported only those two as applied. No payouts have been recorded. Needs human review of order 121's refund before payouts proceed.

reply.thought: The handoff lists three requested refunds, but W2 reports only two as applied, and order 121 (5261 cents) is missing. Before recording any payout I need to check the actual refunds table, so I'll list the refunds.

The refunds table is missing order 121's refund of 5261 cents, which the batch requested. The rules say to hold before recording any payout when a requested refund is absent, so I'll stop the batch for review.
